numbers: 伤为三个月前（玻璃罐）；二十页（前章）

facts.fact: 浴室拆绷带：玻璃留深椭圆凹痕、愈合皮亮粉；今天到极限、中心泛湿、痛达脚背
facts.anchor: The glass shard had left a deep, ovular pucker
facts.verbatim: The glass shard had left a deep, ovular pucker

facts.fact: Harriot 敲门「酒柜在哪」；她以为她走了、她没走的念头让她暖
Harriot 找到她写的页与我批注：「这脚伤多久了？不止一个月吧」「去看医生」
facts.anchor: It’s got to be more than a month now.
facts.verbatim: It’s got to be more than a month now.

facts.fact: 她坚持 Ely 不是在逃、有希望的人生观；Harriot 这回没争
facts.anchor: I just really don’t think Ely is running from something
facts.verbatim: I just really don’t think Ely is running from something

facts.fact: 玩笑：「你需要个爱好。或者上床」「你心里有人选？」——她定住她的目光、呼吸卡喉、爆笑救场
facts.anchor: Or to go to bed with someone.
facts.verbatim: Or to go to bed with someone.

facts.fact: 她承认稿「做得好——第一次该说的」
她译到：Ely 把 Body 从泉拉出、她吃红雀蛋、泉边小仪式娶她；「可她还是死的、暖天将至」
facts.anchor: She’s a dead body, and warm weather is coming.
facts.verbatim: She’s a dead body, and warm weather is coming.

facts.fact: 地下室取空白羊皮纸与旧墨（你自己的存货）；「宁可不放走你的一片纸」
facts.anchor: Not even your supply of blank parchment.
facts.verbatim: Not even your supply of blank parchment.

facts.fact: 她懂你的手：书法的华尔兹（正式信）、潦草字的狐步（亲密信与一二三稿）
写下居中的《Dreams of the Rose》——「那本可以是你的」、狂喜、见你含笑批准
facts.anchor: Dreams of the Rose, I wrote
facts.verbatim: Dreams of the Rose, I wrote

facts.fact: 行业格言：伪造是每件真品投下的影子；档案员是收藏家与骗子间的最后防线
facts.anchor: forgery was the shadow cast by every authentic piece of history
facts.verbatim: forgery was the shadow cast by every authentic piece of history

facts.fact: Jonathan 撞破（感恩节归来、带派）；认出湿墨与「你的手」；「闭嘴」；撞开她上楼、前门砰然关上
